Agent Name: Historian_Expert
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly asserted that the first citation on Carl Nebel’s Wikipedia page pointed to an MFAH page and proceeded based on that unverified assumption. The first citation actually points to the Thieme-Becker entry (de.wikipedia.org). This misdirection led subsequent steps to scrape the wrong site and attempt OCR on irrelevant/non-image content, causing the failure to obtain the correct latest year (1927).
